_doc: Examples that DON'T currently run, classified + routed per the operator's policy (2026-07-15). An entry here is a KNOWN failure the guide itself cannot fix on its own — so check-examples reports it as 'known-blocked' (loud, tracked) instead of hard-failing the gate, and KEEPS IT OUT of the shipped guide until it's green. Each entry: `match` (a substring, OR an array of substrings ALL of which must appear, identifying the example(s) uniquely), `file` (chapter path), `reason`, `owner` (who fixes it: a fleet agent / queue issue), `kind` ('compiler' = a filed compiler/runtime bug → corpus-bugfix; 'content' = the example is written wrong → v-guide). RE-RUN LOOP: the harness re-checks every blocked example each run; if one now PASSES, it prints 'BLOCKLIST ENTRY CAN BE REMOVED' so the entry is deleted and the example ships. Nothing is permanently abandoned; nothing broken ships.
